query:
SELECT
                requested.id AS "id!",
                requested.merged_into AS "merged_into?",
                ct.name,
                ct.email,
                ct.updated_at AS "updated_at!"
            FROM (
                SELECT
                    ids.id,
                    (
                        SELECT a.contact_id
                        FROM crm_contact_aliases a
                        WHERE a.retired_id = ids.id
                    ) AS merged_into
                FROM (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM unnest($2::uuid[]) AS ids (id)) ids
                OFFSET 0
            ) requested
            CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
                SELECT id, team_id, company_id, name, email, hidden, updated_at
                FROM crm_contacts
                WHERE id = COALESCE(requested.merged_into, requested.id)
                OFFSET 0
            ) ct
            JOIN team_user tu
                ON tu.team_id = ct.team_id
               AND tu.user_id = $1
               AND (tu.crm_access OR tu.team_role <> 'member')
            LEFT JOIN crm_companies co
                ON co.id = ct.company_id
            WHERE NOT (ct.hidden OR co.hidden IS TRUE) OR tu.team_role <> 'member'
